title: Approvals first given six or more years ago, still being enlarged
question: Which contracting-out approvals keep being extended and enlarged long after they were first given?
finding: 93 amendments heard from 2022-11-07 on enlarge an approval first given six or more fiscal years earlier (by the fiscal year in its number). Airport Commission 40697-14/15 to $1.60 billion; Public Health DHRPSC0004810 to $647.9 million (Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Treatment Services); Airport Commission 43332-16/17 to $420.0 million (Project Management Support Services & Design Build for …).
how: Amendments only. The original fiscal year is the suffix of the old-style number (for example 14/15) or of the “Legacy PSC #” on the newer form; age is the meeting year less that year.
limits: Long programmes (airport terminals, sewer and water capital programmes) are planned to run for a decade or more, and an amendment can add years without adding money. Age alone says nothing about cost or need; the question is whether the work ever came back to City staff.
